mapper.select: SELECT ei.*, p_old.name AS old_material_name, p_old.code AS old_material_code, p_new.name AS new_material_name, p_new.code AS new_material_code FROM wh_ecn_item ei LEFT JOIN product p_old ON p_old.id = ei.old_material_id LEFT JOIN product p_new ON p_new.id = ei.new_material_id WHERE ei.ecn_id = #{ecnId}
